skills.name: benchmarking
skills.description: Guide for building, running, and analyzing Nanvix performance benchmarks. Use this when asked about benchmark setup, execution, or interpretation.

skills.name: build
skills.description: Guide for building, formatting, linting, and spell-checking Nanvix with z. Use this when asked to build or validate the repository.

skills.name: ci-cd-pipeline
skills.description: Guide for Nanvix CI and GitHub Actions workflow behavior, including local pipeline execution and matrix coverage. Use this when asked about CI checks, workflow failures, or release flow.

skills.name: coding-standards
skills.description: Detailed Nanvix coding, documentation, and review standards across Rust, C/C++, Python, and Shell. Use this when asked to implement or review code quality conventions.

skills.name: daemon-development
skills.description: Guide for developing and debugging Nanvix daemons, including guest daemons and host linuxd behavior. Use this when asked about daemon architecture or daemon changes.

skills.name: gdb-debugging
skills.description: Guide for debugging Nanvix guests using GDB remote debugging over the microvm machine type. Use this when asked about attaching GDB, setting breakpoints, or stepping through kernel code.

skills.name: kernel-development
skills.description: Guide for modifying and debugging the Nanvix kernel architecture and kernel-call paths. Use this when asked about kernel internals or kernel implementation changes.

skills.name: library-development
skills.description: Guide for creating and modifying Nanvix libraries under src/libs, including guest no_std and host std crates. Use this when asked about library architecture or crate changes.

skills.name: test-development
skills.description: Guide for writing, running, and debugging Nanvix unit, integration, and system tests in Rust and C/C++. Use this when asked about test implementation or failures.

skills.name: test
skills.description: Guide for running Nanvix tests with z. Use this when asked to run unit tests, integration tests, or the full test suite.

skills.name: troubleshooting
skills.description: Guide for diagnosing Nanvix build, runtime, and test failures, including cleanup and debugging workflows. Use this when asked to investigate errors or unstable behavior.

skills.name: user-app-development
skills.description: Guide for developing, building, and running Nanvix user-space applications across supported runtimes and languages. Use this when asked about guest app implementation or execution.

skills.name: find-skills
skills.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

skills.name: customize-cloud-agent
skills.description: Skill for customizing the Copilot cloud agent (formerly known as Copilot coding agent) environment, including copilot-setup-steps.yml configuration, preinstalling tools and dependencies, runners, and settings. Use when the user mentions copilot-setup-steps, copilot setup steps, or wants to configure the cloud agent environment.

1. ## Response to Turn 1
2. 
3. ### What I Changed
4. 
5. All four fixes (A–D) were applied as code changes. Proof lemma bodies remain `admit()`.
6. 
7. **Fix A — `init`: remove the tautological Err arm**
8. - `src/kernel/src/mm/phys/manager.rs:101` — changed `Err(_) => true` to
9.   `Err(_) => crate::mm::phys::phys_view().manager_ready`. `init` returns `Err`
10.   only on double-init (the singleton is already set), so the manager is already
11.   ready. `grep "Err(_) => true"` in `manager.rs` now returns nothing.
12. 
13. **Fix B — `alloc_many_kernel_frames`: restore contiguity + no-leak**
14. - `src/kernel/src/mm/phys/manager.rs:426` — Ok arm now asserts
15.   `kernel_frames_contiguous(final(frames)@, count as nat)` (the
16.   `∃ base. base%ps==0 ∧ ∀i. frames@[i]@ == base + i*ps` fact) alongside the
17.   existing `all_free`/`book_all` set effect and `len() == count`.
18. - `src/kernel/src/mm/phys/manager.rs:432` — Err arm now asserts
19.   `final(frames)@.len() == 0` (vec emptied, no leak) in addition to
20.   `final(self)@ == old(self)@`. Discharged from `frames.clear()` (vstd
21.   `Vec::clear` ensures `@ == Seq::empty()`) on the cleanup path; the
22.   input-check and `alloc_contiguous?` Err paths leave `frames` untouched at
23.   `len 0`.
24. - `src/kernel/src/mm/phys/manager.spec.rs:125` — new helper
25.   `kernel_frames_contiguous(frames, count)` encapsulating the nested
26.   `∃ base / ∀ i` contiguity (triggered on
27.   `region_frame_addrs(base, count*ps)`) to keep quantifier triggers controlled.
28. - `src/kernel/src/mm/phys/manager.proof.rs:75` — strengthened
29.   `lemma_kernel_alloc_contiguous` `ensures` with
30.   `kernel_frames_contiguous(frames, count)` (body still `admit()`).
31. 
32. **Fix C — `alloc_many_user_frames`: restore distinctness**
33. - `src/kernel/src/mm/phys/manager.rs:183` — Ok arm now asserts
34.   `user_addr_set(final(frames)@).len() == count`.
35. - `src/kernel/src/mm/phys/manager.proof.rs:114` — strengthened
36.   `lemma_user_bulk_ok` `ensures` with
37.   `user_addr_set(frames).len() == count` (body still `admit()`).
38. - Recorded **OBS-2** in `verus-ai-logs/nanvix-phys-phys-manager/bugs.md`.
39. 
40. **Fix D — `alloc_kernel_frame`: restore the liveness Err fact**
41. - `src/kernel/src/mm/phys/manager.rs:361` — Err arm now asserts
42.   `old(self)@.free_count() == 0` in addition to `final(self)@ == old(self)@`.
43. - `src/kernel/src/mm/phys/manager.rs:368-393` — expanded `frame::alloc()?` into
44.   an explicit `match` so the liveness lemma can be invoked on the early-return
45.   Err path (`:373`), and added the `else` branch on the `KernelFrame::new`
46.   result (`:390`).
47. - `src/kernel/src/mm/phys/manager.proof.rs:54` — new admitted lemma
48.   `lemma_kernel_alloc_err_empty(pre) requires pre.wf() ensures
49.   pre.free_count() == 0`.
50. - Recorded **OBS-3** in `bugs.md`: the liveness fact is soundly dischargeable
51.   only on the allocator-exhaustion path; the `KernelFrame::new` wrapping-failure
52.   branch (which returns `Err` after a *successful* `frame::alloc`, where
53.   `free_count() >= 1`) is an open contradiction flagged for the proving phase,
54.   with `frame.rs`/`kframe.rs` spec evidence. Not silently dropped.
55. 
56. ### Verification
57. 
58. `make verify-kernel MODULE=mm::phys`:
59. ```
60. === Summary ===
61.   verification: 20 verified, 0 errors (exit 0)
62.   cheating: assume=0 external_body=24 admit=11 trusted=0 no_decreases=0 cfg_gate=10
63.   coverage: 24/45 exec functions have contracts
64.   status: CHEATING_DETECTED   # admit()/external_body counts only — expected in spec phase
65. ```
66. 
67. `make verify` (full, no regressions):
68. ```
69. === Results ===
70.   Exit code : 0
71. ```
72. 
73. `./z build -- check-kernel` (non-verus dual compilation):
74. ```
75. {"reason":"build-finished","success":true}
76. [OK]    Build complete.
77. ```
78. 
79. ### Result: FIXED
80. 
81. All four reviewer requests landed as code changes. `make verify-kernel` and
82. `make verify` are Exit 0, and the non-verus build is green. The Fix D
83. `KernelFrame::new` soundness caveat is recorded as OBS-3 with spec evidence (per
84. the reviewer's "do not silently drop" instruction) for the proving phase to
85. resolve.
